full_judgment:
2. Short facts, necessary for disposal of the case, are that the suit land under District Joypurhat, Police Station Khetlal, Mouza Polingo had been possessed by Pritish Chandra Nandi and Sree Tapan Kumar Nandi; they got the property by inheritance. The suit property and other property were enlisted as vested property. Then said Pritish and Tapan filed Other Class Suit No. 211 of 1982 for releasing their property from the V.P list and for decree in the suit. On 04.03.1991 by registered kabala No.1455 they sold 66 decimals of land to plaintiff No.1, who owns and possesses the said 66 decimals of land. On 23.10.1991 by registered kabala No.4615 they sold 33 decimals of land to plaintiff No.2, who owns and possesses the land and plaintiff No.1 takes necessary care on behalf of plaintiff No.2. Accordingly, D.P. Khatian No.970 and 103 were prepared in the name of the plaintiffs. One Afzal Hossain purchased 87 decimals of land from the said vendor and he possessed the said portion and the Court granted injunction. Mutation khatian was also prepared and the plaintiffs pay the rent to the Government. The plaintiffs own and possess the suit property marked red in the sketch map in schedule 5. Plaintiff No.1 is a service holder and plaintiff No.2 is a house wife. The defendants have no right, title, interest and possession over the suit property. The defendants tried to dispossess the plaintiffs from the suit property on 17.01,2003. Hence, the plaintiffs filed the suit for permanent injunction. 

 3. Defendant Nos. 1-8 contested the suit by filing written statement denying all the material allegations made in the paint. They stated, inter alia, that, under M.M.R. Khatian No. 273 the land belonged to Jatish Chandra Nandi, Nagendra Nath Nandi and Jogendra Nath Nandi. By amicable settlement Nagendra Nath took the whole property. Nagendra Nath Nandi died leaving three sons Pritish, Tapan and Udai Kumar Nandi. By amicable settlement Pritish took 43 decimals of land, Tapan Kumar Nandi took 43 decimals of land and Udai Kumar Nandi took 100 decimals of land. Udai Kumar Nandi sold 100 decimals of land on 11.09.2002 to defendant Nos.6, 7 and 8, and defendants Nos. 2, 3, and 4 vide kabala deeds Nos. 4338 and 4340 respectively.
